newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN SAYS REJECTS HC&C FUND REQUEST.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN SAYS REJECTS HC&C FUND REQUEST.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry on Monday it had rejected a request by Harvard Capital and Consulting (HC&C) to open its closed-ended mutual funds.
"The reason (for rejecting the proposal) is securing the protection of unit holders (of Harvard funds)," a ministry statement said.
In mid-January, HC&C said it had applied to the Finance Ministry to transform its closed-end unit trusts into open-end funds in order to "extend investment opportunities."

HC&C said that if the measure was approved, it would offer to buy out shareholders from the funds, which were created in the second wave of the government voucher privatisation programme, at a price equal to the net asset value per share.
Harvard funds are trading at less than 50 percent of net asset value per share.
Harvard officials were not immediately available for comment.
